THE IMPROVEMENT ERA, MAY, 1942

To Our Friends In Utah:

The four Utah stores of Sears, Roebuck and Co. believe you

will be interested in learning that the employees of our company are large stockholders. Sears employees own a little less than 20%

of the total stock of the company. More than $100,000.00 at current

market values is owned by our employees here in Utah.

We also believe you may be interested to know that the company maintains a Profit Sharing and Pension Fund which is considered by many authorities to be the best of its kind in the United

States. Under this plan, any employee with more than a year's

service is permitted to deposit 5% of his earnings in this fund. The

company, in turn, contributes a large share of its profits. For

the year 1941, for every dollar that an employee with less than 5 years service deposited, the company contributed $1.38; for

every employee with five to ten years service the company contributed $2.12 for every dollar deposited; for every employee with

over ten years service, the company contributed $2.86 per dollar

deposited.

The company believes that its employees are partners in the business, therefore they should share in any prosperity which the company may enjoy.

Sears, Roebuck and Company SALTLAKE, OGDEN, PROVO, LOGAN, UTAH
